evidence_A: Gradual KV corruption in PD mode is characterized, but no root cause is identified and no fix is linked.

title: [Bug] MiniMax-M3 incorrectly routes Ascend FuseEP through the normal MoE path
evidence_A: The MoE forward dispatch checks only is_deepep() and omits is_ascend_fuseep(), sending FuseEP through forward_normal and its extra all-reduce; the fix reroutes it.
evidence_B: MiniMaxM3MoE checks only is_deepep() and omits is_ascend_fuseep(), so FuseEP falls into forward_normal(), which then performs a TP all-reduce on output that FuseEP already globally combined.

title: [Bug] Qwen3.5 with  inductor ,the precision is incorrect
evidence_A: Accuracy is wrong only with the inductor piecewise compiler, and the closed fix PR makes the MoE forward op a graph split under inductor.
evidence_B: The reporter's own fix adds the MoE forward function to the inductor compiler's split-op list, implying it was missing a case already handled for the deepep/mooncake backends.

title: [DFlash] Infinite loop when using repetition_penalty — missing token accumulation and scaling penalties
evidence_A: The DFlash verify path never accumulated committed tokens or applied repetition penalties, so the parameter was silently ignored; the fixes add the missing penalty handling.
evidence_B: BatchedRepetitionPenalizer is never registered in the penalty orchestrator, and DFlash's speculative verification path separately never accumulates committed tokens into penalizer state, so the penalty is never applied.

title: [Bug] Silent NaN corruption when serving VLM model without visual encoder weights
evidence_A: The trigger is a checkpoint missing its visual-encoder weights, whose uninitialized parameters give NaN that warmup caches (a prefix-slot reuse path then spreads it), and the fix only adds fail-fast validation of unloaded parameters.
evidence_B: load_weights() never checks whether every parameter was actually populated from the checkpoint, so an uninitialized visual encoder is silently used and its NaNs get cached.

title: [Bug]: [Gemma4] gibberish output for long inputs with images on SM90 FlashAttn4
evidence_A: The FA4 mm_prefix mask dropped the model's sliding-window constraint (causal OR mm_prefix) and used a relative instead of an absolute q_idx; the fix restores both.
evidence_B: The FA4 mask builder implements "causal OR mm_prefix" instead of "(causal AND sliding_window) OR mm_prefix", omitting the sliding-window term that the Triton backend's path effectively enforces.

title: [Bug] GPT-OSS with DP attention enabled produces garbage output (GSM8K 0/128 vs 124/128)
evidence_A: With DP attention, forward_normal all-reduced expert partials that were reduced again later, and the fix removes the duplicate MoE reduction.
evidence_B: With MoE all-to-all disabled and DP attention on, forward_normal() still performs a TP all-reduce on expert output that was already summed across ranks, double-counting it.

title: [Bug] Kimi-K3 EP32: severe repetition and accuracy regression with MegaMoE, not observed with DeepEP
evidence_A: The reporters state they have not identified the cause of the MegaMoE repetition, and no fix is linked.

title: [Bug]: DSV4 sparse MLA emits garbage (gsm8k ~0%) with the packed KV layout from #44577
evidence_A: The packed KV layout makes each component's per-block stride the whole block span; the cache-store op honors it, but the FlashInfer sparse-MLA decode addresses tokens by flat per-token stride and ignores it.
evidence_B: The packed-KV change makes each component's per-block stride the whole packed span, and the cache-store op honors this new stride while the sparse-MLA decode path still assumes the old per-token stride convention.

title: [Bug] DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 abnormal accuracy output when dp < tp
evidence_A: Garbage output when dp < tp is reported without any cause or fix.
evidence_B: Only a repro and garbled output are given; no cause is identified and no PR is linked.

title: [Bug]: Triton MoE and block-FP8 GEMMs mishandle the K tile — an out-of-bounds weight read, and wrong scales when a tile spans two quantization groups
evidence_A: The kernels lack K-tile guards: the last-iteration weight load is unmasked, and nothing clamps BLOCK_SIZE_K <= group_k as the sibling launcher does, so a tile spanning two quantization groups uses one scale.
evidence_B: Both Triton GEMMs are missing a masking/clamping case that an equivalent sibling kernel already applies: one leaves the weight load unmasked at the final K tile, the other doesn't clamp BLOCK_SIZE_K to the quantization group size.

title: [Bug][NPU] ModelSlim W8A8 checkpoint of Qwen3.8-27B (GDN hybrid) loads with garbage weights: fused in_proj_qkvz scheme unresolved, vision encoder forced unquantized; NPU quant matmul crashes on 3-D vision input
evidence_A: The fused in_proj_qkvz name misses the checkpoint's per-projection quantization scheme, so the loader defaults to unquantized and copies int8 weights raw into bf16 parameters.
evidence_B: The scheme-lookup code resolves several checkpoint naming variants but has no case for the GDN model's fused in_proj_qkvz/in_proj_ba parameter names, so the lookup misses and the quantized weights load raw into bf16.

title: [Bug] [GLM5.2] When the tools are set to required mode, the output becomes repetitive and garbled.
evidence_A: Repetitive output with tool_choice=required is reported without a cause or fix.
evidence_B: Only a repro request and the garbled-output claim are given; no cause or fix is present.

title: [Bug] [ROCM] Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 Generates Garbage Response
evidence_A: The ck-tile blockscale GEMM ran on the default stream instead of the caller's current HIP stream, which breaks producer/consumer ordering under overlap scheduling; the fix uses the current stream.
evidence_B: The ck-tile blockscale GEMM was launched on the default HIP stream regardless of the caller's actual (non-default, overlap-scheduling) stream, breaking the producer/consumer execution ordering the caller relied on.

title: [Bug]: Triton attention softcap returns NaN for large attention logits
evidence_A: The softcap's exp-based tanh overflows to inf/inf = NaN for large logits, and the fix uses a numerically stable form.
evidence_B: apply_softcap computes tanh via raw exponentials that overflow to inf for large ratios, so the result becomes inf/inf = NaN.

title: [Bug]: EPD correctness test produces different output for multi-image prompts
evidence_A: The EPD test's multi-image output differs from the baseline, but no cause or fix is described.
evidence_B: Only differing outputs between the EPD and baseline runs are shown; no analysis or fix is given in the text.

title: [Hybrid SSM] Investigate accuracy divergence between `mamba_chunk_scan` and `selective_state_update` kernels
evidence_A: Both explanations are bf16 precision: intermediate bf16 casts in one kernel per the issue, or bf16 lm_head ULP ties per the closed PR, which only stabilizes the test.
evidence_B: The linked resolution finds the "regression" is bf16 lm_head ULP-tie argmax flips near a logit near-tie, and fixes the flaky test's threshold rather than either SSM kernel.

title: [Bug] Mooncake PD silently accepts mismatched Mamba SSM state dtypes/item lengths
evidence_A: Prefill and decode used different Mamba SSM dtypes, and the transfer applied the source item length as the destination stride with no check, corrupting decode state.
evidence_B: SGLang accepts mismatched prefill/decode Mamba SSM state dtypes without validation, and the transfer copies using only the source item length, so BF16-vs-FP32 state layouts silently disagree.

title: `AutoTokenizer` produces wrong token IDs for all Granite models (silent v4→v5 regression)
evidence_A: AutoTokenizer routed Granite to GPT2Tokenizer, which hardcodes a ByteLevel pre-tokenizer in place of the one declared in tokenizer.json; the fix loads tokenizer.json faithfully.
evidence_B: AutoTokenizer routes Granite models to GPT2Tokenizer, which hardcodes a GPT-2 pre-tokenizer regex, instead of respecting the checkpoint's own tokenizer.json pre-tokenizer that the BPE was actually trained with.

title: [Bug]: Llama-4-Scout-FP8 tool calls left in content (not parsed into tool_calls) — pythonic parser vs JSON output mismatch, breaks Claude Code
evidence_A: The llama4_pythonic parser does not recognize the JSON tool-call form this checkpoint emits, and the fixes add a JSON fallback to the parser.
evidence_B: With the Llama-3.1 JSON chat template this checkpoint emits JSON-formatted tool calls, but the selected llama4_pythonic parser only recognizes the pythonic form, so the two configured components disagree on output format.

title: [Bug]: User-authored <|image_pad|> in text is misrecognized as image placeholder, causing image binding mismatch
evidence_A: Media binding matches placeholder tokens by value rather than provenance, so a user-typed image_pad token takes the image meant for the template slot.
evidence_B: Placeholder-to-image binding matches on raw token value, not provenance, so a literal user-text token that happens to share the image placeholder's special-token id can consume the queued image update.

title: [Bug]: V1 Engine Produces Incorrect Scores for Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B on Long Sequences (>8K tokens)
evidence_A: The reporter blames an async copy race (enforce-eager does not help), but the merged fix says the trigger is torch.compile plus chunked prefill (eager is correct) and does not show its mechanism.
evidence_B: query_start_loc is copied to GPU with non_blocking=True and read by the pooling cursor before that copy is guaranteed complete, i.e. the value is read before the moment it becomes valid.

title: [Bug]: GPT OSS Router GEMM Causing NaNs
evidence_A: The NaNs are bisected to the custom router GEMM PR, but no mechanism or fix is described and the issue closed as stale.
evidence_B: A causal commit is referenced by number but its mechanism is never described in the text, and no PR is linked here to supply one.

title: [Bug] Intel XPU: TP token-id sync corrupted — xccl all_reduce(MIN/MAX) silently does SUM, breaking grammar/structured decoding.
evidence_A: Intel XPU's oneCCL backend silently computes SUM for integer all_reduce MIN/MAX (NCCL is correct), which corrupts the TP token-id sync.
evidence_B: The xccl/oneCCL backend on Intel XPU does not implement integer MIN/MAX all_reduce and silently substitutes SUM, while the identical code is correct on NVIDIA/nccl.

title: [Bug]: Streaming output incorrectly mapped to `reasoning` field instead of `content` when `enable_thinking=False`
evidence_A: With enable_thinking=False, streaming puts the text in reasoning while non-streaming does not, but neither the issue nor the linked PR states the mechanism.

title: [Bug]: MergedColumnParallelLinearWithLoRA fails under TP when fully_sharded_loras=False due to incorrect all_gather in apply
evidence_A: apply() always took _mcp_apply, which all-gathers unconditionally even when lora_a is replicated, and the fix gates the all_gather on fully_sharded_loras.
evidence_B: _mcp_apply() unconditionally all-gathers the shrink buffer with no branch for fully_sharded_loras=False, where lora_a is already replicated and no gather should happen.

title: [Bug] Qwen3.5-4B CEval accuracy drops ~4.1% when using SGLang (both on GPU and NPU), but works fine with vLLM
evidence_A: A ~4% CEval gap versus vLLM is reported with no analysis or fix.
evidence_B: Only a cross-engine accuracy comparison and launch command are given; no cause is identified and no PR is linked.

title: [Bug] NemotronH --mamba-scheduler-strategy extra_buffer accuracy drop on AIME26 (Nemotron-3-Super-120B)
evidence_A: The tracking code indexes packed intermediate SSM states by per-request chunk counts, while the kernel writes them on one global chunk grid over the batch, so the wrong state is cached; the merged fix corrects the indexing.
evidence_B: _init_track_ssm_indices computes offsets assuming a per-request-local contiguous count, but the kernel it reads from indexes states by a global physical chunk grid, so unaligned earlier requests cause a wrong state to be read.

title: DeepSeek-Coder v1 tokenizer produces incorrect output on transformers v5+ (gap in PR #44801's fix)
evidence_A: Following the tokenizer_class declared in tokenizer_config.json, transformers loads SentencePiece-based LlamaTokenizer, which cannot apply the ByteLevel-BPE pipeline in tokenizer.json; the fix routes these models to TokenizersBackend.
evidence_B: DeepSeek-Coder v1 declares model_type llama and matches the registered class exactly, so the MODELS_WITH_INCORRECT_HUB_TOKENIZER_CLASS override never fires and it falls through to the wrong (SentencePiece) tokenizer class.

title: [Bug] DCP on GLM-5.3-Flash (norope MLA): virtual locs used raw against per-rank KV buffers — index-K OOB crash + state-dependent quality corruption past max_total_num_tokens
evidence_A: DCP virtual KV locations are used without translation against per-rank buffers because the norope write kernel and the sparse read paths lack DCP rank localization.
evidence_B: The norope KV-write kernel has no DCP_RANK/DCP_WORLD_SIZE translation that the rope variant has, so virtual (global) locations are used raw against per-rank-sized physical buffers.

title: [Bug]: --load_format fastsafetensors produces corrupted/incoherent generation for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with TP+EP (works with default loader)
evidence_A: The reporter only suspects that fastsafetensors mis-maps or mis-shards weights under TP+EP, with no mechanism confirmed and no fix linked.
